snippet.title: Syphon Filter: Logan's Shadow (2007) - Official E3 2007 trailer | PSP & PS2
snippet.description:
Syphon Filter: Logan's Shadow is a TPS game in the Syphon Filter-series, released 2007 by Sony for Playstation Portable and 2010 for PS2.

How do you hunt in the shadows... when the shadows are hunting you?

Unseen, unheard and unknown - Gabe Logan, Precision Strike Operative, is no stranger to secrecy. But when Logan's latest mission to capture a lethal weapon incriminates his closest allies, an intimate secret threatens to become a deadly lie.
